name.baseName: Nuclear spent fuel, in reprocessing, at plant

dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: The factor for infrastrucure requirement has been calculated using THORP annual throughput of 1200 tonne heavy metal (modelled herewith practically as all uranium) for 30 years operation. Recent radioactive and non-radioactive emission data exist from an environmental report of La Hague (Cogema, FR) for both units UP2 and UP3 in the years 1996 and 1997. Radioactive releases to air and sea are given only for aggregated classes. Also the input for the use of main chemicals is from the French facilities. Material transports are estimated using ecoinvent standard distances with the exception of the transport of spent fuel from Swiss power plants to reprocessing facilities in UK and FR. The volumes for the six radioactive waste types to deliver to the intermediate repository and then to the final repository for high and intermediate radioactive waste have been taken from the old Swiss project for final repositories (Gewähr, 1985); UUID: 377a457f-38f9-4fc0-907a-9201a6979e3e

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Current commercial facilities.

# Included processes
The module includes: main chemicals for the operation; glass, steel and cement for the conditioning of the high and intermediale radioactive wastes; transport of spent fuel to the reprocessing plant, and transport of all materials; radioactive and non-radioactive solid waste streams; radioactive and non-radioactive emissions to air and sea.
